description: Prefixes each body paragraph with its sequential position in the document. Numbers are assigned when the PDF is produced and are not stored, so inserting a paragraph renumbers everything after it — do not cite them across revisions.

themeKeys.description: Colour of the generated paragraph number.

Where the number is drawn: `margin` sets it beside the text, outside the measure, so the prose keeps its position — a document numbered this way paginates identically to one with numbering switched off. `inline` prefixes it to the paragraph's first line instead, indenting that line and reflowing the paragraph around it. In a multi-column region a margin number goes in the right-hand margin for the rightmost column and on the left for every other one; where the gutter is too narrow to hold it, that paragraph falls back to `inline`.
Separation between a margin-placed number and the text it belongs to. Ignored when placement is `inline`.

sampleContent: Body paragraphs at document and section level are numbered; paragraphs inside admonitions, sidebars, tables and list items are not.
